brief:
UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband was accosted by demonstrators at a restaurant over the government's decision to proscribe Palestine Action, Al Jazeera English reported. The group, which staged disruptive protests at weapons factories and military sites, was designated a terrorist organization by the UK government.

The proscription made it illegal to support, fund, or be a member of Palestine Action.
dek: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband was confronted by activists at a restaurant over the proscription of Palestine Action.
title: Activists confront UK Foreign Secretary over Palestine Action ban
